Field Atlas

A spinning-globe naming drill — countries, mountain ranges, and lakes. Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, then double-click (double-tap on a phone) what you're asked for. Miss one and it comes back around more often. Pinpoint: no borders, drop a pin where the country is, scored by miles off. Neighbors: no map, pick every country that borders it. Name It: one country lights up, tap its name out of 20 nearby ones.

items, weighted toward your weak spots

Once a pool drops below everything in a mode, it's rebuilt each round from whichever items currently give you the most trouble. Countries too small to click precisely (Vatican City, Kiribati, Nauru…) get a faint marker that lights up as your cursor gets close; in Lakes mode, every lake gets that marker, since some are tiny. A miss auto-rotates the globe to reveal where the answer actually was. Pinpoint scores 100 for a pin on or inside the country, one point less per 10 miles off. Neighbors scores the borders you got as a share of the real ones plus any wrong picks.
